# Musical Work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MusicalWork`](gmeow-MusicalWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MusicalWork>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A work whose primary content is music — the abstract artistic conception independent of any particular notation, performance, or recording. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md); identity is unaffected by realization mode or notation system (Principles 4, 9, 11).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MusicalWork`](gmeow-MusicalWork.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the abstract musical conception — the composition itself, the [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier, surviving any notation, performance, or recording unchanged (the oral-tradition guarantee).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a notated score or a sound recording (those are [`gmeow:ScoreEdition`](gmeow-ScoreEdition.md) / [`gmeow:Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md) at the [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) tier) and for a particular performed/notated realization (that is a [`gmeow:Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md) with [`gmeow:realizationMode`](../properties/gmeow-realizationMode.md)).

### How to use

- Mint the [`MusicalWork`](gmeow-MusicalWork.md) at the [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier; hang realizations below with [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](../properties/gmeow-realizedThrough.md) and recordings/scores further down — never require a notated form ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### Examples

- ex:eroica a [`gmeow:MusicalWork`](gmeow-MusicalWork.md); [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](../properties/gmeow-realizedThrough.md) ex:eroicaScore.
